items.title: Submit cost estimate and photos of damage (or expert report if over €1,000)
items.quote: Schicken Sie uns den Kostenvoranschlag und Fotos der Schäden bitte innerhalb von 12 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens (Werktage sind Montag bis Samstag; Sonntage und gesetzliche Feiertage zählen nicht mit).
items.computation: This is a private deadline set by the insurer, counted from the letter's own date (29.09.2025), a Monday. Under §§187, 188 BGB the day of the triggering event is not counted, so counting starts on 30.09.2025. The letter itself defines 'Werktage' as Monday–Saturday, excluding Sundays and statutory public holidays. Counting qualifying days from 30.09.2025: 30.09 (Tue, day1), 01.10 (Wed, day2), 02.10 (Thu, day3), 03.10 (Fri) is Tag der Deutschen Einheit, a nationwide public holiday, so it does not count, 04.10 (Sat, day4), 05.10 (Sun) excluded, 06.10 (Mon, day5), 07.10 (Tue, day6), 08.10 (Wed, day7), 09.10 (Thu, day8), 10.10 (Fri, day9), 11.10 (Sat, day10), 12.10 (Sun) excluded, 13.10 (Mon, day11), 14.10 (Tue, day12). The 12th qualifying Werktag is Tuesday 14.10.2025. Since that day is itself a normal working day (not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday), no further shift is needed.
